title: Andrew Basiago claims he went back to the Gettysburg Address

tellings.quote: Andrew Bosiago let's just get clear he literally says I went back to the Gettysburg address.

plain: A man named Andrew Basiago claims he travelled back in time to be present at Lincoln's Gettysburg Address in 1863. Michels mentions this himself in a conversation with Grant Cameron, a researcher of the UFO subject, stressing that Basiago "literally says" he went back. He raises it as an example of how far some claims about secret programmes go.
